newsitem.title: USA: Wainoco to sell Canadian oil operations to Numac.
newsitem.headline: Wainoco to sell Canadian oil operations to Numac.

text.p: Wainoco Oil Corp said Monday it agreed to sell its Canadian oil and gas interests to Calgary-based Numac Energy Inc for C$133.6 million prior to purchase price adjustments from January 1, 1997 to closing.
The deal is expected to close by June 16, Wainoco said.
In addition to acquiring the assets, Numac will retain many of Wainoco's Canadian employees who are located in Calgary and in three field offices, Wainoco said.
Wainoco said it intends to use the net proceeds from the transaction to repay its debt obligations and potentially to fund future growth activities.

After the sale of the company's Canadian oil and gas operations, Wainoco said it will focus its business in the downstream segment of the oil and gas industry, building upon its Frontier refining operations, which are based in Denver and Cheyenne, Wyo.
